paite: Lungmuan un, ka mite lungmuan un, na Pathian un a chi.
english: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

paite: Jerusalemte kiangah lungmuan lamsangin thugen unla, a galdouna uh hih zoh a hitaa, a khelhna uh ngaihdam ahi a, a thil hih khelh tengteng gun ding in Toupa khutta kipan amunihin a muta uh chih hilh un.
english: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem; and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”

paite: Tua! Kikou awin, Gamdaiah Toupa lampi bawl unla, gam keu-ah I Pathian adingin lamlian kilualsak un.
english: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

paite: Guam chih sansak ahivek dinga, tang chih mual chih niamsak ahi ding: lampi kawite tansak ahi dinga, a phokna lailai hihlual ahi ding:
english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.

paite: Huan, Toupa thupina hihlat ahi dinga, mi tengtengin huai a mu diamdiam chiat ding uh: Toupa kamin lah a genta ngala, a chi a.
english: The glory of Yahweh shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Tua! awin, Kikou in, a chi. Huan, miin, bang thu gen din kaki kou dia? a chi-a. Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, a thupina tengteng uleng pawna pak bang ahi.
english: The voice of one saying, “Cry!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.

paite: Toupa huin a mut jiakin loupa a vuaia, a pak a tul nak: mite jaw loupa bang ahi mahmah uhi.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

paite: Loupa a vuaia, a pak a tul jel: i Pathian thu ubel khantawn in a om gige ding, chiin, a chi a.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

paite: Zion kianga a tanchin hoih hilh mi aw, tangsang mahmahte khawngah vahoh tou un; Jerusalem kianga tanchin hoih hilh mi aw, ngaihtakin na aw suahin; suahin, lau ken; Juda khuate kiangah, En un, na Pathiah uh!
english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength. Lift it up. Don’t be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

paite: En un, Toupa Pathian mi hattak bang in a hongpai sin hi; a banin a sikin vai a hawm ding: en un, a kipahman lah a kiangah a om hi, a ditna leng amaah a om.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

paite: Aman belamchingpa bangin a belamhon a vak dinga, belamnoute a banin a pomkhawm dinga, a ang sunga koihin a paipih dinga, noukailaite bel awlawl in a pi hiathiat ding, chiin.
english: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

paite: Kuan ahia tuite a khutpek kuak lela teha, tunga van khap lela teh a, leia leivui tehna khat lel a thun veka, tangte lah khaina lel a khaia, mualpawngte lah bukna lela buk?
english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

paite: Kuan ahia Toupa kha thilhih dan ding kawkmuh? ahih keileh kua ahia amah lemsehsak hi-a amah chi?
english: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahweh, or has taught him as his counselor?

paite: Aman kua a dong a, kuan ahia amah theisaka, vaihawm lampi ensaka, theihna hilha, theihsaimna lampi ensak ngei?
english: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

paite: Ngaiin, namchih lah baltina tui tak khat bang lel ahi ua, buknaa banghiam nen bang lela seh ahi ua, ngaiin, aman lah tuikulh gante thilneu neuchikte bangin a dom jel hi.
english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

paite: Lebanon nangawn khul tham ahi keia, a gama gante leng halmanga kithoihnatham ahi sam kei hi.
english: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

paite: Namchihte lah a maah bangmahlou bang ahi ua, amah ngaihtuahin bangmahlou sanga tawm jaw, huihkhua lel ahi uhi.
english: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

paite: Pathian kua toh teh dia kisa na hi ua? Ahihkaleh, bang lim ahia amah toh na teh ding uh?
english: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?

paite: Milim bawltawm zaw, nasem miin a sunga, dangkaeng sek min dangkaeng in a luan khum a, huai adingin dangka khainiangte a sunsak jel
english: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

paite: Huchibang thilpiak pe zou lou-a, genthei lo mahmahin sing muat lou ding a tel jel, milim bawl tawm, ling lou ding, amah adia bawlkhiak sak ding khutsiam mi a zongjel hi.
english: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up an engraved image for him that will not be moved.

paite: Na lungsim un na theingei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za ngei kei ua hia? a tunga kipan in hon hilh kei ua hia? Lei pian chila kipanin na theisiam kei ua hia?
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard, yet? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

paite: Amah jaw lei kualkhumna tunga tupa ahi, amah mitmuhin leitunga omte khaupe bang lel ahi uh, amah jaw tunga van puanin tung banga kai palha, Puan in omna ding a jak a, miliante bangmahlou suaksakpa ahi.
english: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in;

paite: Amah leitunga vaihawmmite bangmahlou-a bawl nakpa ahi.
english: who brings princes to nothing; who makes the judges of the earth like meaningless.

paite: Ahia, suan ahi kei ua; ahi, a tuh ahi kei uh; ahi, a kung un leiah zung a kai kei: huailouin aman amau a muta, a vuai ua, pingpeiin buhsi a lak mang bangin a la mang nak hi.
english: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

paite: Kua toh honteha, kua kimpih lela honsep dek na hi ua? Mi siangthouin a chi
english: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

paite: Tunglam khawngah na mit uh haksak unla, huai thilte khawng kua siam hiam en un; aman tuh sepaihte kizomzom in a pi khe jela, a min chiat un a sam jela; a hatna thupina jiak leh thilhihtheihna lama a hat jiakin khat lel leng kimlo a om ngei kei uhi.
english: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. by the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, Not one is lacking.

paite: Jakobte aw, Bangchia hichibanga chi na hi ua, Isrealte aw, bangchia, hichibanga thugen na hi ua, Ka lampi jaw Toupa laka sel ahi a, a honvaihawmsakna ka Pathian laka lak mang ahi, chih?
english: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God?”

paite: Na lungsim in na theingei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za ngei kei ua hia? Khantawn Pathian. TOUPA kawlmong Siampa, a bah ngei keia, a gim ngei sam louhdan; a theihsiamdan zon khiak vual ahi kei hi.
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, The Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

paite: Bahte kiangah thilhitheihna a pe jela; hatna him him neiloute a hatsak naknak hi.
english: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

paite: Tuailaite nangawn leng a bah un a gim ding ua, tangvalte leng a puk zou ding uh:TOUPA ngakten jaw a hatna uh a thaksak nawn ding ua; muvanlaite bangin khain a leng tou ding ua; gim louin a tai ding ua; bah louin khein a pai ding uhi.
english: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

paite: TOUPA ngakten jaw a hatna uh a thaksak nawn ding ua; muvanlaite bangin khain a leng tou ding ua; gim louin a tai ding ua; bah louin khein a pai ding uhi.
english: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
